All eyes will be on Town Moor at 3.35pm, when 11 runners go for glory in the St Leger Stakes - live on Sky Sports Racing from Doncaster Friday 11 September 2026 17:35, UK Image: Enceladus takes his chance in the St Leger at Doncaster Enceladus takes on Ballydoyle duo Christmas Day and Pierre Bonnard in the latest renewal of the St Leger. 3.35 Doncaster - Enceladus faces Christmas Day and Pierre Bonnard in St Leger The 250th renewal of the Group 1 Betfred St Leger looks a cracker, with Aidan and Joseph O'Brien set to dominate a field of 11. Joseph O'Brien took this race with Galileo Chrome in 2020 and looks to have a super chance with Enceladus . The son of Sea The Stars has progressed with each start, including when winning the King George V at the Royal meeting. He warmed up for a crack at this with a ready success in the Gordon Stakes and may go off the market leader under Billy Loughnane. St Leger: Big race runners guide Leger tips!
